text_block_list.text:
The time has come, at long last! My
springtime
hurdle leading to the
Classics—my Dragon Gate!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
...You look confused, Trainer. Do you
know the
story of the Dragon Gate?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Of course! Long, long ago, in ancient
China, it
was said that if a carp could
leap to the top of
this great waterfall, it
would transform into a
dragon.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Which means if I can clear this hurdle, I'll
turn into
a dragon too!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
So just for today, the name's
Matikarp-streamer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Carp streamer, high above the
rooftops! ♪ A
giant carp swimming in a
cool summer stream! ♪
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list:
Isn't that a Children's Day song? It's only
March...

text_block_list.text:
Singing that tune got me pumped up!
Watch me
blast my way up that waterfall
and to the finish
line!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
